content.json:
# 🤖 proxyClaude Team Dashboard

Usage telemetry for Claude Code via GitHub Copilot proxy.

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "ProxyRequest"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Users = dcount(tostring(customDimensions.user))
content.title: Active Users

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "ProxyRequest"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| count
content.title: Total Requests

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "ProxyRequest"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize TotalTokens = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.inputTokens) + todouble(customMeasurements.outputTokens))
| project Tokens = format_number(TotalTokens, "N0")
content.title: Total Tokens

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "ProxyRequest"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Cost = round(sum(todouble(customMeasurements.estimatedCostUSD)), 2)
| project RetailValue = strcat("$", Cost)
content.title: Retail Equivalent Cost

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "ProxyRequest"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests = count(), InputTokens = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.inputTokens)), OutputTokens = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.outputTokens))
  by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: 📈 Daily Usage Trend

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "ProxyRequest"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests = count() by Model = tostring(customDimensions.model)
| order by Requests desc
content.title: 🧠 Model Distribution

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "ProxyRequest"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions.success) == "false"
| summarize Errors = count() by ErrorType = tostring(customDimensions.errorType)
| order by Errors desc
content.title: ⚠️ Error Breakdown

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "ProxyRequest"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend Hour = toint(customDimensions.hourOfDay), Day = tostring(customDimensions.dayOfWeek)
| summarize Requests = count() by Day, Hour
| extend DayOrder = case(Day == "Mon", 1, Day == "Tue", 2, Day == "Wed", 3, Day == "Thu", 4, Day == "Fri", 5, Day == "Sat", 6, 7)
| order by DayOrder asc, Hour asc
| project Day, Hour, Requests
content.title: 🕐 Activity Heatmap (Hour × Day)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "ProxyRequest"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend user = tostring(customDimensions.user)
| summarize
    Requests = count(),
    InputTokens = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.inputTokens)),
    OutputTokens = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.outputTokens)),
    CacheTokens = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.cacheReadTokens)),
    AvgLatencyMs = round(avg(todouble(customMeasurements.durationMs)), 0),
    EstCost = round(sum(todouble(customMeasurements.estimatedCostUSD)), 2),
    Errors = countif(tostring(customDimensions.success) == "false"),
    LastSeen = max(timestamp)
  by user
| extend ErrorRate = iff(Requests > 0, round(100.0 * Errors / Requests, 1), 0.0)
| extend CacheRate = iff(InputTokens + CacheTokens > 0, round(100.0 * CacheTokens / (InputTokens + CacheTokens), 1), 0.0)
| project User = user, Requests, InputTokens, OutputTokens, CacheRate, AvgLatencyMs, EstCost = strcat("$", EstCost), ErrorRate = strcat(ErrorRate, "%"), LastSeen
| order by Requests desc
content.title: 👥 Per-User Breakdown

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "ProxyRequest"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(timestamp) by tostring(customDimensions.user)
| summarize NewUsers = count() by bin(FirstSeen, 1d)
| order by FirstSeen asc
| extend CumulativeUsers = row_cumsum(NewUsers)
| project Date = FirstSeen, NewUsers, CumulativeUsers
content.title: 📊 Adoption Curve (Cumulative Users Over Time)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "ProxyRequest"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize
    Requests = count(),
    Tokens = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.inputTokens) + todouble(customMeasurements.outputTokens)),
    Cost = round(sum(todouble(customMeasurements.estimatedCostUSD)), 2)
  by Model = tostring(customDimensions.model)
| extend AvgTokensPerRequest = round(Tokens / Requests, 0)
| project Model, Requests, Tokens, AvgTokensPerRequest, Cost = strcat("$", Cost)
| order by Requests desc
content.title: 🔬 Model Usage Details

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "ProxyRequest"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions.success) == "true"
| summarize
    P50 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.durationMs), 50),
    P90 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.durationMs), 90),
    P99 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.durationMs), 99)
  by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: ⚡ Latency Percentiles (P50/P90/P99)
